# Approved NTT DATA logo required

Place the current approved corporate logo here as:

```text
ntt-data-logo.svg
```

The presentation uses a text fallback while the file is missing. The fallback is for development only and must not be represented as the official logo.

Requirements:

- preserve the original aspect ratio;
- do not recolor or redraw the logo;
- retain adequate clear space;
- use an asset approved by your NTT DATA brand owner or supplied with the project.
